Execute fn:git-merge per docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md:
1. git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
2. git fetch origin main
3. git rebase origin/main on the feature branch
4. Resolve any conflicts
5. gh pr create --base main --title 'OIDC-35: Company onboarding orchestration' --body 'Implements the company onboarding API sequence: POST/GET /api/v1/onboarding'
6. gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
7. Verify branch is deleted from GitHub
